core_obligations: Localize: replace the space by a Noetherian open neighbourhood of the point, so it is Noetherian and sober (proof lines 4117-4122)

Reduce to the components through the point: let the finitely many components through the point be Z_1, …, Z_r with generic points ξ_i, and note their union is a neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 4123-4128)

Compute on a component: for a point of Z_i the difference of the two dimension functions equals the difference of the two codimensions computed inside Z_i, which is independent of the point, so the difference is constant on each component and hence locally constant (proof lines 4129-4137)
proof_roadmap: 把 X 缩成 x 的 Noetherian 开邻域 ⇒ 不妨设 X Noetherian 且 sober。
取过 x 的有限个不可约分支 Z_1, …, Z_r（X Noetherian ⇒ 有限），其并是 x 的邻域；取泛点 ξ_i。
对 y ∈ Z_i，δ(x) − δ(y) = −codim(闭包{x}, Z_i) + codim(闭包{y}, Z_i)（由 dimension-function-catenary 的公式）⇒ δ − δ' 在每个 Z_i 上常数。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that two dimension functions on a locally Noetherian sober space differ by a locally constant function (author lemma at source lines 4109-4115, label lemma-dimension-function-unique). The proof (source lines 4117-4138) localizes to a Noetherian open neighbourhood, reduces to the finitely many irreducible components through the point and computes the difference on each component through the codimension formula, which makes it constant there (proof lines 4117-4137). The reduction to the components through the point is the substance. H3.
